tenancy_rules: A business requires available commercial space, legal permission, demand and a persistent business entity.
Commercial space has finite capacity and rent/lease/assignment state where the economy model supports it.
A famous venue on one canonical station is not automatically cloned to same-design stations.
Business failure, relocation, ownership change and closure preserve history.
Open hours and worker shifts are business schedules, not station-wide watch policy.
resident_rules: Families/dependents appear only when facility design, operator policy and mission permit long-term residency.
Permanent residents consume habitation, medical, food, education/recreation and evacuation capacity.
Large starbases may form neighborhoods/communities; micro-outposts may have no non-duty residents.
Population does not regenerate when player arrives.
visitor_rules: Visitors require an arrival path, access/clearance state and a reason for presence.
Docking does not grant unrestricted station access.
Transient visitors leave according to itinerary/ship/service state.
Visitors do not become persistent residents merely because the player interacted with them.
ai_boundary: AI cannot invent a shop, bartender, tenant, family or visitor to decorate a scene.
AI may describe only resolved residents/tenants/visitors or propose candidates for deterministic world validation.
